title: My Project, Grimwar Fantasy Tactics!
author: dank_nuggins
selftext:
Been working on this project by myself for over a year, recently picked up vibecoding about a month back and its taken off! My plan is to replace all AI generated assets with handcrafted assets, so I started a kickstarter to do so!

I'm not too happy about the anti-AI sentiment that's pretty rampant, but I still have hope my game is strong enough in concept and design that I can push through that and use this success to fund my bigger ideas! 

Would love some feedback, if you want links to support the project let me know! I'm doing this all out of pocket so far, and I live on disability, so its not exactly easy. Thanks for reading!

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body: Um. If you're doing AI solo dev, why do you need a Kickstarter?
